summary: The root كُلْأَةٌ (kulʾah) refers to pasturage or herbage, something that is guarded or preserved. It is related to the idea of protection and sustenance for livestock.

headwords.gloss: He preserved; guarded, himself from him; it; had a care of
headwords.def: اكتلأ مِنْهُ (assumed tropical:) He preserved, or guarded, himself from him or it; had a care of, or was cautious of, him or it. (S, K. *) اكتلأت عَيْنى (assumed tropical:) My eye was wakeful, vigilant, or cautious. (S.) اكتلأ كُلْأَةً , and , He received a كُلْأَة [i. e., an earnest, or money paid in advance ]. (K.)

headwords.gloss: Fresh herbage; pasture; what cattle &c. feed upon

parts.t: a gen. n., having no sing.; or its sing. is

headwords.def: كَلَأٌ Fresh herbage; syn. عُشْبٌ : (S, K:) applied to the عُرْوَة , نصِىّ , and صِلِّيَان : (Az:) or pasture, or what cattle &c. feed upon: (TA:) or herbage. whether fresh or dry either fresh pasture or fodder: (S, K:) or it comprises the صِلَّيَان نَصِىّ , حَلَمَة , شِيح , عَرْفَج , the various kinds of عُرْوَة , and what are termed عُشْب , بَقْل , and the like: or it is applied to the herbs called بقل , and to trees: a gen. n., having no sing.; or its sing. is كَلَآءٌ . (TA.)
